name: Mollie
summary: A European payment service provider for cards, bank methods, wallets, hosted checkout, recurring payments, and platform payments.

pricing.headline: Public per-method pricing with country-specific rates; volume and IC++ pricing are available.
pricing.assumptions: Select seller country and payment method before estimating; there is no single cross-market rate.

sellerCoverage: Mollie supports businesses in the EEA, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom, and as of 2026-06-18 is fully operational in every EEA country including Croatia and Iceland, with additional eligibility conditions in some countries.
buyerCoverage: International buyer payment coverage depends on the enabled method, currency, and merchant location.
products: Eligible European commerce, SaaS, subscriptions, platforms, and in-person businesses.

features.checkout: Hosted Checkout, payment links, components, APIs, and plugins.
features.invoicing: Payment links and integrations can collect invoices; complex billing logic may need another layer.
features.paymentMethods: Cards, iDEAL/Wero, Bancontact, SEPA, wallets, BNPL, and other European methods.
features.payouts: Settlement timing and currency depend on method and merchant configuration.

responsibilities.note: The business remains seller and contracts with its buyer.
Mollie provides payment services, not an MoR transfer of seller liability.
Mollie supplies payment controls and dispute processes while the merchant owns exposure.
The business supports customers and billing operations.

limitations: Pricing requires method and country context
Tax filing and full SaaS billing remain merchant responsibilities
bestFor: Teams wanting a regional Stripe alternative
avoidIf: Your business is outside supported seller regions
